unresolved_gaps: No reviewed source establishes how much the restrictions changed DeepSeek's development decisions or efficiency gains relative to what it would otherwise have achieved.
The evidence supports leading language-model competitiveness, not parity across China's entire AI industry.
The causal suggestion is explicitly tentative, so lack of causal identification cannot fairly be treated as its disproof.
